SELECT concat(ifnull(t2.province, ''), '*', ifnull(t2.electricity_tax_phone, '')) AS taxSystemKey, t2.province AS province, t2.electricity_tax_phone AS electricityTaxPhone, count(t2.id) AS accountSetCount FROM fxy_financial_account_sets t2
where 1=1 #[AND t2.electricity_tax_phone = :electricityTaxPhone] #[and t2.province = :provinceName]
GROUP BY t2.province , t2.electricity_tax_phone, concat(ifnull( t2.province, '') , '*', ifnull( t2.electricity_tax_phone, '') )

SELECT t.id AS id, t.company_name AS companyName, t.create_date AS createDate, t.credit_code AS creditCode, t.vat_type AS vatTypes, t.electricity_tax_code AS electricityTaxCode, t.province AS province, t.electricity_tax_phone AS electricityTaxPhone, t.zero_declarations AS zeroDeclarations FROM fxy_financial_account_sets t LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_user_account_sets t1 ON t1.account_sets_id = t.id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_user t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.id WHERE t.electricity_tax_phone = :electricityTaxPhone #[AND t.province = :province] GROUP BY t.id
